pageTitle: We build software that helps teams
pageDescription: Since 2019 we've been on a mission to replace bloated, overpriced CRMs with something fast, human and genuinely useful.
storyP1: In 2019, our founders were running a small sales team and spending more time fighting their CRM than talking to customers. Every tool was either too simple to scale or too complex to actually use.
storyP2: So they built the tool they wished existed — fast, focused and priced fairly. Six years later, that same product powers sales teams in 48 countries, and we still ship every two weeks.
value1Desc: Every roadmap decision starts with a real customer problem, not a competitor's feature list.
value2Desc: Powerful doesn't have to mean complicated. We remove friction before we add features.
value3Desc: We're humans building for humans. Support is treated as a product, not a cost center.
value4Desc: Your data is yours. We ship security and transparency, not dark patterns.
mile1Desc: Founded by three engineers frustrated with bloated CRMs.
mile2Desc: Crossed 1,000 paying teams and launched workflow automation.
mile3Desc: Opened offices in Dubai and London, added 12 languages.
mile4Desc: Launched Automation 2.0 and hit 99.9% uptime SLA.
ctaDesc: We're hiring across engineering, design and customer success.
